interpretation.admission: Only an explicit manager admission changes lifecycle to active; admission still leaves dispatch false.
interpretation.blank_close: The shipped work.blank_project dynamically composes one initial-specification DAT document and project.documents/specification association from the rendered shared projection in the same FND transaction. Fresh reads show the empty initial revision and template revision; untouched idle-close retains project/spec/revision/association and removes only the registered checkout file.
interpretation.creation: A blank pending project is written immediately with zero tasks, empty outcome, no manager/budget/allowance, and a committed creation receipt.
interpretation.query_edit_attach: Fresh ProjectSheet export observes the pending project and one pinned initial-spec document association after an ordinary sheet edit; curator and why/revisit metadata survive.
interpretation.remaining: No named C38/S-NEW-01 foundation behavior remains unexercised in this bounded installed proof. Full Otto host action remains C39/later and is not pulled into foundation.
interpretation.replay_invalid: Same logical request replays the same identity without a new event; changed arguments raise a replay conflict.
interpretation.revisit: A typed wait records owner, awaited reference, revisit condition and residual why metadata; readiness observation is attention-only and keeps pending/admission/dispatch false.
